newsitem.title: FRANCE: Accor up strongly after profit forecast.
newsitem.headline: Accor up strongly after profit forecast.

text.p: Shares in French hotel group Accor rose by over two percent on Wednesday morning after the company forecast higher net and operating profit for 1997.
At 0946 GMT, the stock was up 1.65 percent at 863 francs after hitting a day high of 868 francs.
Accor chairman Jean-Marc Espallioux told the annual shareholders meeting he expected a rise of more than 20 percent in gross operating profit for 1997 as well as a marked rise in net profit.
The stock rose 6.65 percent on Tuesday ahead of the AGM on expectations Espalioux would outline further restructuring steps.
The stock slipped back from its session high a few minutes later to trade at 856 francs, up 0.8 percent.
It hit a year high on May 21 of 912 francs.
